inclusion_rules: Every normalised listing returned by the stream endpoints during the window is archived exactly once, keyed by (source, source_id); first-seen version wins.
Listings already live at window start (seen in the first poll of each stream) are archived with baseline=1; they are part of the window archive.
Superteam listings carry no source creation timestamp in the public payload; first_seen_at is our poller's detection time and source_created_at is null for that stream.

No contact enrichment: listing-level fields only, exactly as published by the source. Poster identifiers are stored as published (ugig poster UUIDs; Superteam sponsor names). No emails, no social handles, no scraped data beyond the listing endpoints.

integrity.anchor: public GitHub repository commit history (hsharmanov02/seeker-node, demos/futurecapture/)
integrity.record_hash: sha256 of canonical JSON of the archived record (fields above, excluding seq/prev_chain_hash/chain_hash)
integrity.root_publication: running root (last chain_hash + record count) published to the public capture page at commitment, at least twice during the window, and at window close

known_blind_spots: A listing born and deleted entirely inside one poll interval (30-45s) may never be observed.
Endpoints return bounded pages (25/25/50, newest-first); a burst of new listings larger than the page between polls can push a short-lived listing out before observation.
Edits to a listing after first capture are not versioned in this MVP; the first-seen version is the archived one.
Deletion is inferred by absence at census time; endpoint pagination can mimic deletion (counts are labelled estimates).
Poller outages create gaps; every gap interval is logged and published in the close manifest rather than hidden.

payment.matching: unique amount per order (price + order-specific milli-suffix) or buyer-registered transaction hash; read-only chain polling; we never sign or send

future_24h.terms: prepaid archive of the next scheduled 24h window over these streams, delivered at close

future_7d.terms: prepaid archive of the next scheduled 7d window over these streams, delivered at close

future_event48h.terms: prepaid archive of a 48h event-bounded window, scheduled with the buyer

option_next_window.terms: premium for the right to buy the next scheduled 24h window archive at the locked strike of 59 USDC at its close; lapses worthless if not exercised

verification_at_close: Independent spot-checks during the window (at least 6): sample up to 50 currently-live records across the three streams; after a 150s grace period, confirm presence in the archive. Completeness = found / sampled.

Deletion census at close: archived (source, source_id) pairs absent from fresh polls of all three streams at close are counted as 'only in our archive' (deleted/filled/paginated-out upstream; reported as an estimate with the census method stated).
Delivered archive: JSONL of all archived records + manifest (spec hash, window, counts, chain root, spot-check history, gap log) whose records re-verify against the in-window published roots.
